fixedAssembly.requiredUnits: degrees Celsius GMST anomaly, source 1961-1990 reference before source-defined rebasing

fixedAssembly.yearPolicy: Require every 1850-2025 row once with 200 finite native members. Preserve and report, but exclude, any 2026 row because it is not a completed annual observation. No interpolation or endpoint extension.
fixedAssembly.baseline: Subtract the 1850-1900 inclusive mean of the annual ensemble median from all members, as operative GWI does. Never individually rebase observation members.
fixedAssembly.identity: Keep original member IDs; record source and protocol SHA-256 and actual raw-file git blob SHA-1
fixedAssembly.checks: Reject duplicate/missing years or members, nonfinite values, noninteger years, wrong header/version, summary quantiles and reference-period mismatch; independently recompute common offset and prove between-member differences survive unchanged
fixedAssembly.output: Hashed private annual observation-member NetCDF plus focused public evidence with exact commands and counts; only descriptive source-assembly diagnostics, no target scoring
